description: This file implements plugin discovery logic for the OpenClaw project, including functions for scanning directories, resolving plugin paths, handling cache, and filtering plugin candidates based on security checks.

methods.name: clearPluginDiscoveryCache
methods.description: Clears the internal cache of plugin discovery results.

methods.name: resolveDiscoveryCacheMs
methods.description: Determines cache duration based on environment variable.

methods.name: shouldUseDiscoveryCache
methods.description: Checks if plugin discovery cache should be used based on environment variables.

methods.name: buildDiscoveryCacheKey
methods.description: Constructs a cache key for plugin discovery based on parameters.

methods.name: currentUid
methods.description: Returns current process user ID, or null on Windows or if unavailable.

methods.name: checkSourceEscapesRoot
methods.description: Checks if plugin source path escapes the plugin root directory.

methods.name: checkPathStatAndPermissions
methods.description: Checks file system permissions and ownership for plugin candidate paths.

methods.name: findCandidateBlockIssue
methods.description: Aggregates security checks to determine if a plugin candidate is unsafe.

methods.name: formatCandidateBlockMessage
methods.description: Formats a human-readable message for security issues blocking a plugin candidate.

methods.name: isUnsafePluginCandidate
methods.description: Determines if a plugin candidate is unsafe and logs diagnostics.

methods.name: isExtensionFile
methods.description: Checks if a file has a supported extension and is not a TypeScript declaration file.

methods.name: shouldIgnoreScannedDirectory
methods.description: Determines if a directory should be ignored during scanning based on its name.

methods.name: resolvesToSameDirectory
methods.description: Checks if two paths resolve to the same directory.

methods.name: readPackageManifest
methods.description: Reads and parses package.json from a directory, respecting hardlink rejection.

methods.name: deriveIdHint
methods.description: Generates an ID hint for a plugin candidate based on filename, manifest ID, or package name.

methods.name: resolveIdHintManifestId
methods.description: Loads plugin manifest to get its ID for use as an ID hint.

methods.name: addCandidate
methods.description: Adds a plugin candidate to the list after performing security checks.

methods.name: discoverBundleInRoot
methods.description: Detects and loads plugin bundle manifests in a directory.

methods.name: resolvePackageEntrySource
methods.description: Resolves the source path for a package's entry point, considering hardlink restrictions.

methods.name: discoverInDirectory
methods.description: Recursively scans a directory for plugin candidates, including extensions, bundles, and index files.

methods.name: discoverFromPath
methods.description: Starts plugin discovery from a given path, handling files and directories.

methods.name: discoverOpenClawPlugins
methods.description: Main entry point for discovering plugins, with caching and directory scanning based on environment and configuration.
